# Draft:HH Prince DeAndre, Duke of Hanumanteshwar

HH Prince DeAndre, Duke of Hanumanteshwar
Early Life and Background
HH Prince DeAndre, Duke of Hanumanteshwar, was born on December 28, 1978. He became a member of the Indian royal family through his marriage to HRH Prince Manvendra Singh Gohil, the 39th direct king of Rajpipla. His career spans advocacy, entrepreneurship, and philanthropy, with a significant focus on LGBTQ+ rights, cultural preservation, and social impact initiatives.
Career and Advocacy
Prince DeAndre serves as the Creative Director of H1927 and H1927LLC, organizations specializing in publishing, e-commerce, and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) professional services. Through these ventures, he advances social justice and cultural empowerment.
As a co-author of A Royal Commitment: Ten Years of Marriage and Activism, Prince DeAndre provides a firsthand account of his journey with HRH Prince Manvendra, highlighting their activism and its impact on LGBTQ+ rights. The book explores their experiences navigating royal traditions while advocating for human rights.
In addition to his literary contributions, Prince DeAndre has been a leader in using fashion as a platform for activism through his initiative "Fashion for a Cause." Under his direction, H1927 integrates haute couture with philanthropic initiatives, redefining luxury fashion while supporting social causes.
Public Speaking and International Engagements
Prince DeAndre is a frequent speaker at conferences and events advocating for inclusivity, LGBTQ+ rights, and cultural preservation. His engagements include the Gold Rush Pride Summit, collaborations with UFCW21, and other global forums.
His work extends internationally, with upcoming wellness and literary retreats in Rajpipla, India. These retreats integrate yoga, cultural experiences, and literary discussions, aligning with his commitment to holistic well-being and heritage preservation.
Publishing and E-Commerce
Through H1927LLC, Prince DeAndre has established an independent publishing house that amplifies voices focusing on resilience, identity, and empowerment. His e-commerce platform offers exclusive products, including signed editions of A Royal Commitment and other cultural merchandise.
Personal Life
Prince DeAndre and HRH Prince Manvendra Singh Gohil hold the historic distinction of being India’s first same-sex married royal couple. Their marriage represents progress in LGBTQ+ visibility within traditional societal structures.
He divides his time between the United States and India, balancing his roles as a royal, activist, and entrepreneur.
Recognition and Impact
Prince DeAndre's contributions have positioned him as a global thought leader in LGBTQ+ rights, cultural heritage, and social entrepreneurship. His ability to bridge historical legacy with modern advocacy continues to influence discussions on inclusivity and equality.
